items.text: J.P. Morgan Called a Potential Elon Musk SpaceX-Tesla Merger "Strategically Coherent"
items.summary_cn: JPMorgan称SpaceX与Tesla潜在合并'战略上合理'，若成行将重塑Musk系公司架构，直接利好kcn持有的SpaceX ETF。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Says His Goal Is for SpaceX to Be Worth More than the Entire Earth
items.summary_cn: Musk公开目标：让SpaceX市值超过整个地球GDP总和，极度看多自家公司，直接强化SpaceX估值叙事。

items.text: The SpaceX IPO made history. One month on has it lost momentum?
items.summary_cn: 新闻讨论SpaceX IPO一个月后表现与动能，Musk话题引关注，直接关联kcn持有的SpaceX相关标的。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s startling claim to SpaceX investors
items.summary_cn: 新闻聚焦Musk向SpaceX投资者做出的惊人表态/承诺，对SpaceX估值叙事至关重要，直接影响kcn持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX and Amazon are tech dopplegangers worth $4.5 trillion—and they're headed for a collision
items.summary_cn: 报道将SpaceX与Amazon并列为4.5万亿美元科技双雄，称两者业务正面碰撞，影响SpaceX估值想象空间。

items.author: Trump
items.text: In honor of Senator Lindsey Graham, a big supporter, the U.S. Senate should pass the Clarity Act. China, and many other countries, would like to take complete and total control of this major financial “happening,” as well as A.I., where we are now leading, but where they are fighting hard. Don’t let China win on either subject!!! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump呼吁参议院通过Clarity Act，主张美国在加密货币和AI领域保持领先、阻止中国超越，政策导向利好加密板块。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk and Sam Altman Are Fighting in Public Again
items.summary_cn: Musk与Sam Altman再次公开互怼，OpenAI/xAI口水战升级，反映AI行业内部竞争与叙事博弈。

items.text: The Hormuz Strait is OPEN, and will remain OPEN, with or without Iran. items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla Stock Is Falling. Can Robots Arrive Soon Enough to Save It?
items.summary_cn: Tesla股价下跌，焦点转向Optimus机器人能否及时落地提振估值，间接反映Musk对Tesla未来叙事重心。

items.author: Trump
items.text: BIG WIN at the Supreme Court, in the Slaughter Case, confirming Presidential Power in our Country to remove Executive Branch Officers and Agency Appointees, or Representatives, under Article II. This Decision was long sought by United States Presidents, dating all the way back to the 1930s. It is such an Honor to be the sitting President who won this Historic and Unprecedented Ruling, one of the most important ever given with respect to Presidential Powers. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump庆祝最高法院Slaughter案胜诉，确认总统可依Article II移除行政部门/机构官员，扩大行政权对监管机构影响力。
